captions.caption: A modern garage rock track, with strong drums, male vocals, a distorted guitar riff in the verse, strummed chords in the chorus that has also backing vocals, and an upbeat bridge at the end.
An energetic an fun alternative rock song that features a catchy riff and a bouncy male vocal with some back vocals shouting "it could be you".
